source: stock RainPoint re-enrollment observed by rainpointd plus contemporaneous RainPoint app device-information screenshot

event_boundary.notes: The passive decoders did not retain the initial stock assignment burst. The immediate paired-identity transition nevertheless proves that it was accepted. A raw IQ capture is still required for the stock battery-rejoin reply.

correlations: The app's device address 6 agrees with the selector-6 request family encoded as 0x86 in the paired valve frames.
The decimal app device ID converts to 0x26005329 and appears neither directly nor byte-reversed in the captured pairing frames; it is not promoted as an RF identity.
The app full-battery icon labels this enrollment boundary as normal battery state but does not locate the battery field in RF.
The app RSSI is measured by the stock gateway and must remain distinct from local SDR or radio-node RSSI.
Firmware display 123 is a search clue only; no plain 0x7b, 01 02 03, or ASCII 123 representation was identified in the decoded pairing frames.
